title: Handsomeness
summary: HAND'SOMENESS, noun A moderate degree of beauty or elegance; as the handsomeness of the person or of an edifice. 1. Grace; gracefulness; ease and propriety in manner.

inlines.v: HAND'SOMENESS, noun A moderate degree of beauty or elegance; as the handsomeness of the person or of an edifice. 1. Grace; gracefulness; ease and propriety in manner.
